name: cake
about: A round brown sponge cake on a small white plate, with a pink icing top and a cherry on it, about 0.4 metres across.
code:
m.cylinder(0.25, 0.22, 0.03, { at: [0, 0.015, 0], color: 'white' })
m.cylinder(0.2, 0.2, 0.16, { at: [0, 0.11, 0], color: '#8b5a2b' })
m.cylinder(0.21, 0.21, 0.05, { at: [0, 0.21, 0], color: '#f48fb1' })
for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
  const a = i / 10 * Math.PI * 2
  m.sphere(0.035, { at: [Math.sin(a) * 0.2, 0.19, Math.cos(a) * 0.2], color: '#f48fb1' })
}
m.sphere(0.06, { at: [0, 0.29, 0], color: '#d0102a' })
m.tube([[0, 0.34, 0], [0.03, 0.4, 0.02]], 0.008, { color: '#3a7a2a' })
m.anchor('hand', [0, 0.02, 0])
m.anchor('top', [0, 0.35, 0])
return { carry: 'hand', ride: false, sit: false, wear: null, bouncy: 0, solid: false }
